comparison.objective: Water soil while holding a springy leaf aside and avoiding wet leaves, versus adjust and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1272 requires simultaneous obstruction control and controlled pouring; the candidate requires coaxial fastener manipulation and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1272 scores delivered water, leaf contamination, restored leaf/jug positions, and arm clearance; the candidate scores mechanical setting and retained function.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; liquid delivery around an obstruction is a different tested ability.
